task: Geometry and exterior-reconstruction quality under a shared online coverage budget heuristic

mode_scope.G: Geometry and reconstruction quality under the shared fixed-public-ROI coverage proxy budget
mode_scope.N: Pure coverage selection throughout the same V21 runtime; requires separate explicit preparation

eligibility: coverage >= 0.8, returned_to_anchor, zero collisions, termination.failed == false
reference_mode: Read only existing frozen V19 caches; never copy, regenerate or modify
world_scope: Existing V19 generic stereo surrogate, perfect pose and artificial RGB markers; not ZED calibration
truth_boundary: Evaluator truth and true reachable-floor coverage never enter runtime arguments or feedback; planner uses observed known cells over a fixed public ROI

planning_coverage_proxy.numerator: Observed belief known cells (free or occupied) inside the fixed public task ROI
planning_coverage_proxy.denominator: All cells in the fixed public task ROI; no evaluator reachability or geometry
planning_coverage_proxy.scope: Shared planner reserve heuristic only; the evaluator coverage gate remains unchanged and is checked separately
